title: Detroit River Community Cleanup + Yoga
description: Join us for a morning of intentional movement and positive connection while caring for our riverfront parks.
long_description:
Join us for a morning of intentional movement and positive connection while caring for our riverfront parks.

About this Event

Join us for a community cleanup + yoga along the beautiful Detroit River where we will share a yoga practice, then clean some of the riverfront parks and surrounding areas.

- WHEN:Sunday, October 18th
Yoga
10 am - 11 am
Park Cleanup
11:15 am - 12:15 pm

-WHERE TO MEET:14601 Riverside Blvd, Detroit, MI 48215
PLEASE park on Riverside Blvd OR at Lakewood East Park.

-WHAT TO KNOW:Trash pickers, large adult gloves, kids gloves, and bags provided by The Cleanup Club and Dee's Green Cleaning.Fall on the river is often chilly and muddy, so we recommend wearing warm layers and shoes or boots you don't mind getting dirty.We will weigh all collected trash and share the data with our friends at The Cleanup Club to support their Great Lakes advocacy efforts.Bring your yoga mat if you would like to participate in yoga. We will practice in the park if it's dry, and in the upstairs event space at Coridaner Kitchen and Farm if the grass is wet. All levels are welcome.Bring a reusable water bottle to reduce plastic consumption and to stay hyrdated!

-VOLUNTEER PERKS:60 minute yoga practice with Liz, owner of Full Lotus Yoga - metro Detroit's beloved yoga studio.Stop by Coriander Kitchen and Farm afterwards for a delicious lunch & a complimentary beverage. We recommend making a reservation so you can be sure to get a table!Earn 20% off your first Dee’s Green Cleaning service booked before 12/31/26 - current clients are eligable to redeem this promotion!Making a positive difference in your community and for our Great Lakes! 

Also check out other in Detroit, Health & Wellness events in Detroit, Kids events & activities in Detroit.
